name: Debloat
summary: Turn off analytics, ads and background data collection that macOS lets you control.

options.title: Notify me when macOS undoes a change
options.detail: Shows a notification when macOS switches a disabled feature back on and MacSpace disables it again.

backgroundTasks.title: Keep features disabled
backgroundTasks.detail: Checks every 15 minutes while MacSpace is open, and disables again any feature macOS switched back on.
